title: AO/119/2009 of MAQSOOD AHMAD Vs HARI SINGH

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
 A.O. No. 119 of 2009

Versus
Hari Singh ........ Respondent
 ..........
Mr. Arvind Kumar Sharma, Advocate for the appellant.
Hon'ble V.K. GUPTA, C. J.
 After hearing learned counsel for the appellant, I am convinced that
the learned Court below has rightly rejected the appellant's application for
re-admission of the appeal because a perusal of the impugned order clearly
suggests that, first and foremost, the appellant was grossly negligent in
prosecuting the appeal and had taken as many as 20 adjournments and
secondly, no good ground was made out for re-admission of the appeal.
 This appeal is dismissed in limine.
